studies.label: trypsin-benzamidine MMVT milestoning, no HMR (2 fs)

constraints.value: bonds to hydrogen (rigid hydrogen-heavy atom bonds)

method_details.value: MMVT milestoning (SEEKR2) with concentric spherical milestones at 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16 and 18 Å from the binding-site centre of mass (ligand COM to site COM distance CV); collisions checked every timestep; Voronoi-cell starting structures from a 20 ns NVT steered MD pull from 1 to 13 Å with a moving harmonic restraint of 9000 kJ mol-1 nm-2 (structures beyond 14 Å taken from MMVT collision states); 500 ns MMVT per cell; Brownian dynamics with Browndye 2 (b-surface stage to the 18 Å milestone, then 1000 x 1000 BD trajectories to the 16 Å milestone; 2 million BD trajectories in total; interior/exterior dielectric 4/78; APBS grids; desolvation forces and hydrodynamic interactions on)

claims.what: association rate constant kon (SEEKR2, no HMR)
dissociation rate constant koff (SEEKR2, no HMR)
binding free energy ΔGbind from koff/kon (SEEKR2, no HMR)
